audit.whatIsWrong: TRICKY / 7.5-10 holds at 50.74% over 3104 games; the reasoning named nothing.
audit.why: The lane is decided by Quickdraw — a 16/15/14/13/12s dash that also stacks True Grit resists and drops its own cooldown on hit — not by a generic 'pattern'.
audit.corrected: Kept the rating, re-anchored the phases to Quickdraw's cooldown and True Grit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2 and 4 contradicted the packet AND this entry's own whys.
audit.why: whys[0] says you win first contact but the chart said Graves; whys[4] says Ragnarok wins the level-6 fight but the chart said Graves; whys[2] describes an even read while the chart said Olaf. The packet chart (Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf) matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 4 flipped as one atomic group in both layers, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings call Smoke Screen a blind that stops your autos and 'breaks your attack-speed ramp'.
audit.why: Riot's Smoke Screen text is magic damage, a brief slow on impact, and REDUCED SIGHT RANGE. It does not blind and it does not stop an attack — the mirror reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Restated as a slow plus a vision cut, which is a chasing problem, not a damage problem.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings say Ragnarok 'strips' the smoke and slows and 'gives move speed toward him'.
audit.why: Ragnarok is passive armour and magic resist plus immunity to disables while he keeps attacking. There is no cleanse and no movement speed anywhere in it, and Riot's text does not settle whether slows count as disables.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as disable immunity held by continuing to attack; no move-speed and no slow-immunity claim made.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'True Grit autos' / 'True Grit shotgun autos' treat True Grit as a damage effect.
audit.why: True Grit is the ARMOUR and magic resist buff on Quickdraw — two stacks when he dashes toward a champion, refreshed by his attacks. It is why Reckless Swing's true damage matters and why armour-based reads on him are wrong.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed at Quickdraw's resist stacking, with Reckless Swing named as the answer to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings give Olaf's W omnivamp/sustain.
audit.why: Tough It Out is attack speed plus a SHIELD on 16/15/14/13/12s; the lifesteal is the passive and grows as his health drops.
audit.corrected: Split correctly: shield from W, healing from the missing-health passive.

edits.before: Graves can't really kite you yet — his E-dash is his only reset and at level 1 it isn't even unlocked, so land Q to slow him, walk on top, and let your passive attack speed ramp as his shotgun autos chip you. The catch is his True Grit autos and smoke (W) blind hurt: don't facetank a full magazine, and don't throw Q from max range where he just side-steps it. Bait the E-dash or the smoke, then commit — once those are down he has no answer to your speed.
edits.after: Graves can't really kite you yet — Quickdraw is his only reset and at level 1 it isn't even unlocked, so land Undertow to slow him, walk on top, and let your attack speed ramp as his shotgun chips you. The catch is the resists: every Quickdraw toward you stacks True Grit, and Smoke Screen slows you and cuts your sight, so you lose him mid-chase. Bait the dash or the smoke, then commit — once those are down he has no answer to your speed.

edits.before: This is your window. Your Q cooldown drops with axe pickups so you perma-slow him, W-omnivamp heals back the shotgun poke, and E's guaranteed true damage cuts through his tanky-ADC armor stacking. At 6, Ragnarok strips his smoke-blind off you, ignores any slow he lands, and gives you move speed toward him — so he can't kite, can't disengage, and your E-true-damage finishes. Force the all-in on his E-dash cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. Undertow refunds on every pickup so you perma-slow him, Tough It Out shields the shotgun poke while your missing-health lifesteal heals it, and Reckless Swing's true damage cuts through the True Grit resists Quickdraw stacks. At 6, Ragnarok keeps you disable-immune while you keep swinging, and Smoke Screen only cuts your vision — it never stops an axe. Force the all-in on Quickdraw's 16s.

notes: Smoke Screen as a BLIND ran through six strings and drove the advice: the reader was told his autos get turned off and their attack-speed ramp broken. Riot's text gives a slow and reduced sight range only, so the real cost of the smoke is losing him mid-chase. Ragnarok was also credited with a cleanse and with move speed toward the target; it has neither — passive resists plus disable immunity while attacking is the whole ability. No claim is made about whether slows count as disables under it. Chart rows 0, 2 and 4 flipped to match the packet and this entry's own whys — the page previously said Graves wins level 6 in the chart and Olaf wins it in the text.
